title: Quilt graduation dependency graph — 15 named-scope packages, their roots, the cycle, and the quilt org
method: GitHub REST API (api.github.com/repos/SuperInstance/*/contents/package.json and /git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1) plus npm registry GET https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>. Every 'resolvable' value was evaluated against the live npm registry at generation time.

legend.node.kind: pkg = declares a package name | root = candidate root of the dependency tree | phantom = name referenced but no publishable manifest | foreign = belongs to another party | org = a GitHub organization
legend.node.published: true = present on npm at generation time | false = HTTP 404 from registry.npmjs.org | n/a = not a package
legend.edge.resolvable: true = npm can satisfy this spec from the registry today | false = npm CANNOT satisfy it today
legend.edge.unresolved_why: the concrete mechanical reason npm cannot satisfy the edge

nodes.name: quilt-core
nodes.description: Framework-independent pane layout model, validation, commands, and subscriptions
nodes.note: NAME COLLISION / TRAP. This is NOT SuperInstance quilt-core. It is a browser pane-layout library by a third party. SuperInstance/quilt-core-os has never been published under this name and never can be without the owner cooperating. 18 versions 0.1.0..0.11.0 published 2026-09-14..2026-10-15.

nodes.name: quilt-core
nodes.description: Quilt edge runtime — the TypeScript daemon that ships inside the quilt-core snap.
nodes.note: THE ACTUAL ROOT of the dependency tree, and the product the three blocked dependents need. It DECLARES the name quilt-core — but that name is already owned on npm by node quilt-core, the third-party pane library. Its own name is therefore unpublishable as written.

edges.unresolved_why: workspace: is a monorepo-internal protocol; npm cannot resolve it outside a workspace root (EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL, reproduced). Also forms a cycle with @quilt/evolve -> @quilt/ai.
EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL. Target additionally ambiguous: two in-account packages claim @quilt/core.
EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL. This is the edge that makes quilt-claw uninstallable.
HTTP 404. Source exists at SuperInstance/quilt packages/sdk 0.2.0.
HTTP 404, and the 0.1.0 floor does not match either in-account claimant (0.3.0 scoped, 0.4.0 unscoped).

edges.note: Resolves inside the quilt monorepo only. npm rewrites file: deps at publish time, which is exactly the mechanism the three blocked packages need.
Vendored copy inside the consumer repo. Couples the two packages into one publishable unit.
Vendored JS shim. The upstream repo is Python and has no package.json.

edges.unresolved_why: SUPPLY-CHAIN HAZARD. npm quilt-core@0.11.0 is a third-party pane-layout library. Any manifest declaring quilt-core as * or ^0.11.0 WILL install the third party code and run its lifecycle scripts. Edge marked TRAP. Must never be followed.

DIFFERENT PRODUCTS wanting the same name. quilt-core-os is an edge-runtime snap daemon (better-sqlite3, Apache-2.0, TypeScript daemon). quilt packages/core is a yaml+zod spreadsheet-cell model. Unifying them is a product decision, not a packaging one.

edges.note: The only strong evidence available on who holds the npm @quilt scope: @quilt/quilt is published and its sole maintainer is kevin@quilt.io, matching this org. npm publishes no scope-ownership endpoint and the local token cannot read /-/org/* (403 even for its own profile), so this remains TO BE VERIFIED before any publish.

edges.unresolved_why: The quilt GitHub org (2019-04-03, 38 Ewasm/crypto repos) has no packages/core and no relationship to this account. It grants no npm scope and must not be treated as a destination without Casey asserting ownership.

cycles.note: npm does not forbid cyclic dependencies between two separately published packages. The cycle becomes fatal only under a single-monorepo workspace layout (npm run -ws build deadlocks on topological order) or a naive publish-order script. It is NOT the reason publish currently fails. The reason is workspace:*.

verified_facts_not_in_the_briefing: The unscoped quilt-core on npm is NOT SuperInstance's. It is niko-dellic/quilt packages/core, a MIT pane-layout library with zero dependencies, 18 versions.
@quilt/core v0.3.0 IS declared on the account, at SuperInstance/quilt packages/core, and is a different product from quilt-core-os.
@quilt/sdk v0.2.0 IS declared on the account, at SuperInstance/quilt packages/sdk.
The npm @quilt scope is occupied: @quilt/quilt@0.4.2, maintainer kevin@quilt.io, matching the quiltdata GitHub org.
GitHub user luciddreamer EXISTS (type User, created 2023-04-26, 0 public repos). The org does not. The briefing's 404 holds only for /orgs/luciddreamer.
@cocapn/plato-client has no package.json anywhere; the repo is a Python package.
The quilt-* family in the sketchbook measures 257 repos, not 259.

The seven shared-core repos (quilt-arcade, quilt-arena, quilt-quant, quilt-dba, quilt-mesh, quilt-learn, loom-core) ship a byte-identical engine/engine.js of 28,145 bytes. The briefed 97,486-byte JS + 71,216-byte TS pair does NOT reproduce at HEAD of any of the seven (single 'main' branch each) and is marked UNVERIFIED.
